newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-10-MAN ARSENAL BEAT NEWCASTLE TO GO TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-10-MAN ARSENAL BEAT NEWCASTLE TO GO TOP.

text.p: Arsenal, playing with 10 men after skipper Tony Adams was sent off after 22 minutes, beat Newcastle 2-1 to replace them at the top of the English premier league on Saturday.
Arsenal, who moved two points clear of Newcastle, went ahead through Lee Dixon after 11 minutes before Alan Shearer equalised after 21 minutes.

Adams was sent off for fouling Shearer a minute later but Arsenal overcame that setback and almost constant Newcastle bombardment of their goal to take all three points with a 60th minute winner from Ian Wright, his 19th goal of the season.

Third-placed Liverpool do not play until Monday but Wimbledon, who are fourth, moved on to 28 points, level with Liverpool and one behind Newcastle, after stretching their unbeaten run to 17 matches with a 1-0 home win over bottom club Nottingham Forest.

Sunderland ended Everton's eight-match unbeaten run with a shock 3-1 win at Goodison Park, while champions Manchester United, who fielded a weakened team in losing 2-0 to Leicester in the League Cup on Wednesday, beat the same opponents 3-1 with a full-strength side at Old Trafford to move up to fifth.
